Verified in DuckStation on forced festival days (tools/emu/force_festival.py, hidden emulator; docs/testing.md 'The culture festival'): her answer as a band member (S6I) and her dressing-room scene after the concert. Not seen: the club variants S61-S63 and S6B. Layout and flow in game-internals 6ab. The stage shows (Drama play, Band concert, Literature speech contest) are BUNKA_SD.EXN, still Japanese. Natural triggers, other years and moods checked only statically.
